headline: Rwanda Explores Botanical Potato Seeds to Improve Yields and Reduce Disease
summary: Rwanda's Ministry of Agriculture and Animal Resources is exploring potato-breeding technology using botanical seeds instead of traditional tubers to improve planting access and reduce disease.
why: Agricultural innovations targeting crop disease resistance and seed efficiency can enhance productivity and food security in developing economies.

impacts.name: Rwanda
impacts.why: New agricultural techniques aim to increase potato crop yields.
